title: Step execution precondition test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/step-preconditions/cases.json (registry/plan-step-kinds.json preconditions, docs/installation-plan.md). Each case gives a step of the consented plan, where a precondition needs it the step that follows it in that plan (next_step), and the facts observed right before it runs. The preconditions of the step's kind are evaluated in registry order; expected=allowed: all hold; expected=rejected: the first failing one gives reason_code, the step is not run and the bootstrap operation moves from INSTALLING to expected_next_state with an event of type expected_event. Missing facts fail (fail closed).

next_step.description: The step that immediately follows `step` in the consented plan, when a precondition reads it (replacement_source_verified: the paired import_distro).
